widgets_values: The same Brazilian woman from the reference portrait speaks the supplied audio naturally in a quiet podcast studio. Precise lip synchronization to every syllable in the supplied audio. Stable facial identity, hairstyle, clothing, microphone and background. nodes.title: INPUT 4 · PROMPT DA IMAGEM → personagem
widgets_values: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 documentary portrait, medium close-up from mid-torso. One 35-year-old Brazilian woman with a warm, confident presence. Oval face, defined cheekbones, almond-shaped medium-brown eyes, straight proportional nose, naturally full lips with a defined cupid's bow, slightly asymmetric eyebrows, subtle smile. Blonde hair in soft natural waves with a slightly uneven side part and a few loose strands. Real skin texture, visible pores, faint freckles across the nose, mild natural under-eye shadows, subtle forehead shine, no beauty filter. Natural everyday makeup. Beige blazer with a realistic crease over a plain black top, small discreet earrings. She sits at a dark wooden podcast desk in a professional modern studio. A large black broadcast microphone on a boom arm is positioned beside her mouth without covering her lips. Warm table lamp lights one cheek slightly more than the other. Dark acoustic panels, a softly blurred shelf, two books and a small green plant in the background. She looks slightly left of camera toward an interviewer. Natural shallow depth of field, realistic 50mm photography, restrained colors, no text, no logo, no watermark.

Ajusta o fim do vídeo à duração da fala
LEIA-ME: três prompts separados
widgets_values: COMECE PELO BOX 1: escolha duração e resolução; depois edite somente os prompts de fala, imagem e movimento. 8 s executa os blocos 1-2; 12 s executa 1-3; 25 s executa 1-6. O seletor lazy impede que os blocos longos rodem nos presets curtos. A fala deve caber na duração escolhida; frames excedentes são cortados automaticamente. Mantenha batch_size=1. A resolução 368 x 640 é a opção segura para 16 GB; 432 x 768 usa mais VRAM.
